# Timothy Williamson Archive

> A searchable bibliography of 388 works and 298 digital editions.

The HTML editions contain the complete text of each available edition, including the author's notes and references. Some editions are book excerpts; their scope is identified in the edition metadata. The plain-text versions preserve mathematical expressions as TeX and link to embedded figures. HTML is the primary reading format; plain text is an additional representation of the same edition.

## Catalogue and discovery

- [Browse the archive](https://dkodsi.github.io/williamson-archive/)
- [Search titles and full text](https://dkodsi.github.io/williamson-archive/search/)
- [Timeline and citation connections](https://dkodsi.github.io/williamson-archive/citations/)
- [Catalogue JSON](https://dkodsi.github.io/williamson-archive/data/works.json)
- [Catalogue BibTeX](https://dkodsi.github.io/williamson-archive/exports/timothy-williamson-catalogue.bib)
- [Catalogue CSV](https://dkodsi.github.io/williamson-archive/exports/timothy-williamson-catalogue.csv)
- [Sitemap](https://dkodsi.github.io/williamson-archive/sitemap.xml)
